units.zh: 王融
units.en: Wang Rong
units.literal: Wang Rong

units.zh: 王融字元長，琅邪臨沂人也。
units.en: Wang Rong, whose style name was Yuanchang, was a native of Linyi in Langya.
units.literal: Wang Rong, style name Yuanchang, was a native of Langya commandery in Linyi.

units.zh: 祖僧達，中書令，曾高竝台輔。
units.en: His grandfather Wang Sengda had held the post of Secretary Grand Director, and for generations his family had produced ministers at the highest level.
units.literal: His grandfather Wang Sengda was Secretary Grand Director; his forebears for several generations together had served as director-level ministers.

units.zh: 僧達答宋孝武云：「亡父亡祖，司徒司空。」
units.en: When Sengda replied to Emperor Xiaowu of Song, he said, "My deceased father and grandfather were Chamberlain and Minister of Works."
units.literal: Sengda answered Emperor Xiaowu of Song, saying, "My late father and late grandfather were Chamberlain and Minister of Works."

units.zh: 父道琰，廬陵內史。
units.en: His father Wang Daoyan had been Interior Governor of Luling.
units.literal: His father Wang Daoyan was Interior Governor of Luling.

units.zh: 母臨川太守謝惠宣女，惇敏婦人也。
units.en: His mother was the daughter of Linchuan Administrator Xie Huixuan, a conscientious and capable woman.
units.literal: His mother was the daughter of Administrator of Linchuan Xie Huixuan, a woman of sincere and quick intelligence.

units.zh: 教融書學。
units.en: She personally taught Rong to read and write.
units.literal: She taught Rong reading and writing.

units.zh: 融少而神明警惠，博涉有文才。
units.en: Even as a boy, Rong was exceptionally quick-witted, widely read, and gifted as a writer.
units.literal: Rong in youth was bright and alert, broadly learned and possessed of literary talent.

units.zh: 舉秀才。
units.en: He was nominated as a provincial graduate.
units.literal: He was recommended as a Cultivated Talent.

units.zh: 晉安王南中郎板行參軍，坐公事免。
units.en: He was appointed Acting Aide on the staff of the Prince of Jin'an as Southern Commander-in-Chief, but lost the post over a bureaucratic infraction.
units.literal: He served as Acting Aide in the Southern Staff of the Prince of Jin'an, and was dismissed for an official offense.

units.zh: 竟陵王司徒板法曹行參軍，遷太子舍人。
units.en: The Prince of Jingling in his capacity as Grand Minister made him Acting Aide in the Law Section, after which he rose to Attendant of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: The Prince of Jingling, as Grand Minister, appointed him Acting Aide in the Law Section; he was promoted to Attendant of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 融以父官不通，弱年便欲紹興家業，啓世祖求自試。
units.en: Since his father's career had stalled, Rong even in his youth wanted to restore the family's fortunes and petitioned Emperor Wu to let him prove himself.
units.literal: Because his father's official career had not prospered, Rong while still young wished to revive the family standing and memorialized Emperor Wu to request a trial of his abilities.

units.zh: 曰：「臣聞春庚秋蟀，集候相悲，露木風榮，臨年共悅。
units.en: He wrote: "I have heard that in spring the fifth-month cicada and in autumn the cricket, when the seasons turn, grieve in sympathy; trees bright with dew and wind put forth their glory, and as the year closes all creation shares its joy.
units.literal: He said: "Your subject has heard that in spring the cicada of the fifth month and in autumn the cricket, when the seasons gather, mourn one another; trees touched by dew and wind flourish, and as the year draws near they rejoice together.

units.zh: 夫唯動植，且或有心；
units.en: If even plants and animals can feel,
units.literal: Even among moving things and plants there is sometimes feeling;

units.zh: 況在生靈，而能無感。
units.en: how could a human being remain unmoved?
units.literal: how much more among living beings could there be no response.

units.zh: 臣自奉望宮闕，沐浴恩私，拔迹庸虛，參名盛列，纓劔紫復，趨步丹墀，歲時歸來，誇榮邑里。
units.en: Since I first beheld the imperial precincts and received your personal grace, I was raised from obscurity into the company of the great, belted in purple with sword at my side, walking the vermilion court; each year when I returned home I could boast of honor in my town.
units.literal: Your subject, since gazing upon the palace towers and bathing in private favor, was lifted from mediocrity to join the ranks of the eminent, girded with purple sash and sword, pacing the vermilion steps; when the seasons turned and he returned home, he boasted of glory in his native place.

units.zh: 然無懃而官，昔賢曾議；
units.en: Yet to hold office without real effort—men of old debated that very point;
units.literal: Yet to hold office without diligence—former worthies debated this;

units.zh: 不任而祿，有識必譏。
units.en: to draw salary without performing one's duties—anyone with sense is bound to scorn it.
units.literal: to receive salary without fulfilling one's charge—those with understanding surely deride it.

units.zh: 臣所用慷慨憤懣，不遑自晏。
units.en: That is why I burn with shame and indignation and cannot rest at ease.
units.literal: For this reason your subject is stirred to generous indignation and has no leisure for ease.

units.zh: 誠以深恩鮮報，聖主難逢，蒲柳先秋，光陰不待，貪及明時，展悉愚效，以酬陛下不世之仁。
units.en: Deep grace is seldom repaid, and a sage sovereign is rarely met; like a willow that yellows before autumn, time will not wait—I mean to seize this bright hour and offer whatever poor service I can in return for your unparalleled benevolence.
units.literal: Truly deep favor is rarely repaid, a sage ruler is hard to meet; the willow withers before autumn, time does not wait—I would greedily seize this bright season and display whatever feeble service I have, to repay Your Majesty's unexampled kindness.

units.zh: 若微誠獲信，短才見序，文武吏法，唯所施用。
units.en: If my small sincerity wins your trust and my modest talent is put to use, in civil affairs, military affairs, or the laws of office—employ me as you will.
units.literal: If this slight sincerity wins trust and my limited talent is given rank, whether in civil, military, or administrative law, I will apply myself as you command.

units.zh: 夫君道含弘，臣術無隱，翁歸乃居中自是，充國曰『莫若老臣』。
units.en: The ruler's way is all-embracing, and a minister should conceal nothing: Weng Gui sat in the middle and decided cases himself, and Zhao Chongguo said, 'None better than your old servant.'
units.literal: For the ruler's way is broad and embracing, and the minister's craft should hide nothing: Weng Gui judged cases from his central seat, and Zhao Chongguo said, 'None better than this old minister.'

units.zh: 竊景前脩，敢蹈輕節。
units.en: Taking those earlier models as my guide, I venture this presumptuous request.
units.literal: Secretly taking the former exemplars as my mirror, I dare tread this light step.

units.zh: 以冒不媒之鄙，式罄奉公之誠。
units.en: Though I offend with this uninvited forwardness, I offer the whole of my loyalty to the state.
units.literal: Though I offend with this uninvited baseness, I would fully exhaust my loyalty in public service.

units.zh: 抑又唐堯在上，不參二八，管夷吾恥之，臣亦恥之。
units.en: Moreover, when Emperor Yao sat above, he did not consult his Eight and his Two; Guan Zhong found that shameful, and so do I.
units.literal: Moreover, when Tang Yao ruled above, he did not consult the Eight and the Two; Guan Zhong was ashamed of that, and your subject is ashamed as well.

units.zh: 願陛下裁覽。」
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to consider this petition."
units.literal: I beg Your Majesty to judge and review."

units.zh: 遷祕書丞。
units.en: He was promoted to Secretary Assistant.
units.literal: He was transferred to Secretary Assistant.

units.zh: 從叔儉，初有儀同之授，融贈詩及書，儉甚奇憚之，笑謂人曰：「穰侯印詎便可解？」
units.en: His cousin Wang Jian had just been granted the rank Peer Equal to the Three Dukes; Rong sent him poems and letters, and Jian was both impressed and alarmed, remarking with a smile, "Does the seal of the Marquis of Rang come off that easily?"
units.literal: His cousin Wang Jian had just received the title of Peer Equal to the Three Dukes; Rong sent him poems and letters, and Jian was greatly struck and wary of him, smiling and saying to others, "Can the seal of the Marquis of Rang be so easily taken away?"

units.zh: 尋遷丹陽丞，中書郎。
units.en: Before long he was promoted to Assistant Magistrate of Danyang and Secretariat Gentleman.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to Assistant Magistrate of Danyang and Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 虜使遣求書，朝議欲不與。
units.en: Northern Wei envoys asked for books, and the court debate favored denying them.
units.literal: The barbarian envoys sent to request books, and court discussion inclined toward refusal.

units.zh: 融上疏曰：
units.en: Rong submitted a memorial that read:
units.literal: Rong submitted a memorial, saying:

units.zh: :　　臣側聞僉議，疑給虜書，如臣愚情，切有未喻。
units.en: I have heard the assembly debating whether to give books to the barbarians; in my ignorance I cannot see the sense of it.
units.literal: Your subject has overheard the collective deliberation and doubts about granting books to the barbarians; in my foolish feeling there is much I fail to understand.

units.zh: 夫虜人面獸心，狼猛蜂毒，暴悖天經，虧違地義，逋竄燭幽，去來豳朔，綿周、漢而不悛，歷晉、宋其踰梗。
units.en: The barbarians wear human faces but harbor beast hearts; fierce as wolves and venomous as wasps, they trample heaven's laws and break earth's right order, skulking beyond the frontier between Bin and the northern wastes—unrepentant through Zhou and Han, more stubborn still through Jin and Song.
units.literal: These barbarians have human faces and beast hearts, wolf-fierce and wasp-venomous; they outrage heaven's norms and violate earth's principles, fleeing to the dark beyond the frontier, coming and going between Bin and the north—through Zhou and Han they did not repent, through Jin and Song they grew only more obstinate.

units.zh: 豈有愛敬仁智，恭讓廉脩，慚犬馬之馴心，同鷹虎之反目。
units.en: How could they cherish benevolence and wisdom, practice courtesy and integrity, feel shame at the loyalty of dog and horse, or turn on their masters like hawk and tiger?
units.literal: How could they possess love, reverence, benevolence, and wisdom, courtesy, yielding, integrity, and cultivation—ashamed of the docile heart of dog and horse, sharing the turning against one of hawk and tiger?

units.zh: 設槁秣有儲，筋竿足用，必以草竊關燧，寇擾邊疆；
units.en: Give them fodder in store and bows and poles to spare, and they will surely slip past the beacon fires to harry the borders;
units.literal: Suppose dry fodder were stored and bowstrings and poles sufficient—they would surely use straw to steal past the beacon fires and raid the frontier;

units.zh: 寧容款塞卑辭，承衣請朔。
units.en: never with humble words at the frontier, robes in hand, begging for the imperial calendar.
units.literal: how could they be allowed to come in sincerity to the passes with humble words, receiving robes and requesting the calendar?

units.zh: 陛下務存遵養，不時侮亡，許其膜拜之誠，納裘之賮。
units.en: Your Majesty has chosen to nurture and spare them, not to strike the dying when the moment is wrong, accepting their prostrations and their fur tribute.
units.literal: Your Majesty has devoted yourself to nurturing and preserving them, not despising the dying at the wrong hour, granting their sincerity in prostration and accepting their fur tribute.

units.zh: 況復願同文軌，儻見款遣，思奉聲教，方致猜拒。
units.en: And now they profess to share our script and our ways—if we treat them with courtesy and send them off, while they claim to embrace our civilization, we will only breed suspicion and resistance.
units.literal: How much more if they now wish to share our script and carriage-tracks—if we should happen to send them off in good faith while they think to receive our civilizing teaching, we would only invite suspicion and refusal.

units.zh: 將使舊邑遺逸，未知所寘，衰胡餘噍，或能自推。
units.en: Our loyal subjects in the lost north would not know where to turn, and the last remnants of the barbarians might rally on their own.
units.literal: This would leave the old cities' scattered remnants with nowhere to settle, and the declining Hu's surviving morsels perhaps able to push themselves forward.

units.zh: 一令蔓草難鉏，涓流泛酌，豈直疥癢輕痾，容爲心腹重患。
units.en: Let the weeds run wild and a trickle swell into a flood, and this is no mere rash or passing illness—it may become a mortal threat at the core of the realm.
units.literal: Once creeping weeds are hard to uproot and a trickling stream overflows its cup, how is this merely a scab or a light ailment—it may become a grave malady of the heart and belly.

units.zh: :　　抑孫武之言也，困則數罰，窘則多賞，先暴而後畏其衆者，虜之謂乎？
units.en: Was it not Sun Wu who said that when cornered they multiply punishments, when desperate they multiply rewards, brutal first and only then feared by their followers—is that not exactly the barbarians?
units.literal: Is this not what Sun Wu said—that when cornered they multiply punishments, when straitened they multiply rewards, first brutal and only then feared by their masses? Is this not the barbarians?

units.zh: 前中原士庶，雖淪懾殊俗，至於婚葬之晨，猶巾褠爲禮。
units.en: The people of the Central Plains, though forced under alien rule, still on wedding and funeral mornings wore Chinese dress as ritual demanded.
units.literal: Formerly the gentry and commoners of the Central Plains, though fallen under alien customs, on mornings of marriage and burial still wore headcloths and robes as ritual.

units.zh: 而禁令苛刻，動加誅轘。
units.en: But their prohibitions were savage, and dismemberment by cart-wheel followed every infraction.
units.literal: Yet prohibitions were harsh and severe, and execution by cart-wheel was added at every turn.

units.zh: 于時獯粥初遷，犬羊尚結，卽心徒怨，困懼成逃。
units.en: When the Xiongnu first settled in, the tribes were still bound like dog to sheep; resentment filled every heart, and fear drove men to flee.
units.literal: At that time the Xiongnu had just moved in, dogs and sheep still bound together; hearts only resented, and fear in distress became flight.

units.zh: 自其將卒奔離，資待銷闕，北畏勍蠕，西逼南胡，民背如崩，勢絕防斷。
units.en: Once their commanders and troops scattered, supplies ran out; they feared the powerful Rouran in the north and were squeezed by tribes in the west—the people turned away like a collapsing wall, and their defenses were broken.
units.literal: Since their officers and soldiers fled in dispersion, supplies and support were exhausted; they feared the mighty Rouran in the north and were pressed by the southern Hu in the west—the people's backs turned like collapse, their strength cut off from defense.

units.zh: 於是曲從物情，偽竊章服，歷年將絕，隱蔽無聞。
units.en: So they bent to popular feeling, stole regalia and robes in pretense, and for years on end kept themselves hidden from sight.
units.literal: Thereupon they bent to follow popular sentiment, falsely stealing regalia and robes; the years nearly ran out, and they hid themselves unheard.

units.zh: 旣南向而泣者，日夜以覬；
units.en: Those who had turned south in tears watched day and night for deliverance;
units.literal: Those who had turned south and wept looked day and night with longing;

units.zh: 北顧而辭者，江淮相屬。
units.en: those who looked north and took their farewells lined the Yangzi and Huai.
units.literal: those who looked north and took leave stretched along the Yangzi and Huai.

units.zh: 凶謀歲窘，淺慮無方，於是稽顙郊門，問禮求樂。
units.en: Their plots grew desperate year by year, their shallow counsels failed them, and so they beat their foreheads at the frontier gate, begging for ritual and music.
units.literal: Their wicked plots grew yearly more straitened, shallow counsel had no method—thereupon they knocked their foreheads at the suburban gate, asking for ritual and seeking music.

units.zh: 若來之以文德，賜之以副書，漢家軌儀，重臨畿輔，司隷傳節，復入關河，無待八百之師，不期十萬之衆，固其提漿佇俟，揮戈願倒，三秦大同，六漢一統。
units.en: If we came with civil virtue and gave them duplicate texts, if Han ritual returned to the heartland and the Director of Retainers bore his tally back through the passes—without needing eight hundred men or a hundred thousand soldiers—they would bring provisions and wait, raise spears eager to defect; the Three Qin would reunite and the six regions of Han would be one again.
units.literal: If we came to them with civil virtue and granted duplicate books, Han ritual and regalia returned to the capital region, the Director of Retainers passed his tally and re-entered the passes and rivers—without waiting for eight hundred troops, without expecting a hundred thousand men—they would surely carry provisions and stand waiting, wave spears wishing to topple over; the Three Qin would be great-unified, the Six Han made one.

units.zh: :　　又虜前後奉使，不專漢人，必介以匈奴，備諸覘獲。
units.en: Moreover, in their embassies past and present they never sent only Han men but always mixed in Xiongnu, to guard against every kind of intelligence.
units.literal: Moreover, in their former and later missions the barbarians did not use only Han men but always interposed Xiongnu, guarding against all reconnaissance.

units.zh: 且設官分職，彌見其情，抑退舊苗，扶任種戚。
units.en: In their offices and ranks their intent is plain: they push down the old families and elevate their own kin.
units.literal: In establishing offices and dividing duties their disposition is all the clearer: they suppress and push back the old clans and support and appoint their own kindred.

units.zh: 師保則后族馮晉國，總錄則邽姓直勒渴侯，台鼎則丘頹、苟仁端，執政則目凌、鉗耳。
units.en: Their tutor is Feng Jinguo of the empress's clan; their chief recorder is Zhile Kehou of the Guo clan; their top ministers are Qiu Tui and Gou Renduan; those who govern are Muling and Qian'er.
units.literal: Tutor and guardian is Feng Jinguo of the empress's clan; chief recorder is the Guo-clan Zhile Kehou; director-level ministers are Qiu Tui and Gou Renduan; those holding power are Muling and Qian'er.

units.zh: 至於東都羽儀，西京簪帶，崔孝伯、程虞虯久在著作，李元和、郭季祐上于中書，李思沖飾虜清官，游明根泛居顯職。
units.en: As for the courtiers of the old capitals—Cui Xiaobo and Cheng Yuqiu long served in the Composition Office, Li Yuanhe and Guo Jiyou rose in the Secretariat, Li Sichong held high barbarian office, and You Minggen filled one prominent post after another.
units.literal: As for the feathered regalia of the Eastern Capital and the capped gentry of the Western Capital—Cui Xiaobo and Cheng Yuqiu long served in the Composition Office, Li Yuanhe and Guo Jiyou rose in the Secretariat, Li Sichong adorned their barbarian pure offices, You Minggen broadly held eminent posts.

units.zh: 今經典遠被，詩史北流，馮、李之徒，必欲遵尚；
units.en: Now that the classics reach them and poetry and history flow north, men like Feng and Li will surely wish to honor them;
units.literal: Now the classics reach far, poetry and histories flow north—the Fengs, Lis, and their kind will surely wish to honor and uphold them;

units.zh: 直勒等類，居致乖阻。
units.en: while the Zhile and their kind will only breed obstruction.
units.literal: the Zhile and their sort will in residence produce estrangement and obstruction.

units.zh: 何則？
units.en: Why?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 匈奴以氈騎爲帷牀，馳射爲糇粮，冠方帽則犯沙陵雪，服左衽則風驤鳥逝。
units.en: The Xiongnu take felt tents and horsemanship for their home, galloping archery for their sustenance; in square caps they brave sand and snow, in left-lapel dress they ride the wind like birds.
units.literal: The Xiongnu take felt tents and horsemanship as their bed-curtains, galloping archery as their dry provisions; crowned with square caps they brave sandbanks and snow, clothed in left-lapel dress they ride the wind swift as birds in flight.

units.zh: 若衣以朱裳，戴之玄頍，節其揖讓，教以翔趨，必同艱桎梏，等懼冰淵，婆娑躄，因而不能前已。
units.en: Dress them in vermilion robes and dark caps, teach them bowing and measured steps, and they would feel as shackled, as terrified as over an icy abyss, hobbling and shuffling, unable to go forward at all.
units.literal: If clothed in vermilion robes and capped with dark foreheads, their bowing and yielding regulated, taught the measured pace—they would be alike in hardship as in shackles, equal in fear as before an icy abyss, hobbling and shuffling, and thus unable to advance.

units.zh: 及夫春草水生，阻散馬之適，秋風木落，絕驅禽之歡，息沸脣於桑墟，別醍乳於冀俗，聽《韶雅》如聾聵，臨方丈若爰居，馮、李之徒，固得志矣，虜之凶族，其如病何？
units.en: When spring grass rises and waters flow, they cannot scatter their horses; when autumn wind blows and leaves fall, they cannot hunt for sport; they would cease their clamor at the mulberry altars and leave behind the kumis of Ji—hearing the Shaoya would be like deafness, facing a square hall like living among strangers. Men like Feng and Li would have their way, but the barbarians' fierce clans—how could they endure it except as a mortal illness?
units.literal: When spring grass and waters rise, they block the scattering of horses' ease; when autumn wind and trees fall, they cut off the joy of driving game; they cease chattering lips at mulberry ruins and part from kumis at Ji customs; hearing Shaoya is like deafness, facing a square zhang is like dwelling in Ai—the Fengs and Lis would surely get their wish, but the barbarians' fierce clans—how would they bear it as sickness?

units.zh: 於是風土之思深，愎戾之情動，拂衣者連裾，抽鋒者比鏃，部落爭于下，酋渠危於上，我一舉而兼吞，卞莊之勢必也。
units.en: Then homesickness would run deep, rebellious passions would stir; men brushing their robes would stand shoulder to shoulder, men drawing blades would stand arrow to arrow; tribes would fight below and chiefs would totter above—and we with one stroke would take them all, as Bian Zhuangzi took both tigers.
units.literal: Then longing for native soil would deepen, perverse and violent feelings would stir; those brushing their robes would link hems, those drawing blades would align arrowheads; tribes would contend below, chieftains would be imperiled above—we with one stroke would swallow them both: the momentum of Bian Zhuangzi would be assured.

units.zh: 且棘寶薦虞，晉疆彌盛，大鍾出智，宿氏以亡。
units.en: When the thorn treasure was offered to Yu, Jin's borders grew; when the great bell came from Zhi, the Su clan was destroyed.
units.literal: Moreover, when the thorn treasure was offered to Yu, Jin's borders grew ever greater; when the great bell came forth from Zhi, the Su clan perished.

units.zh: 帝略遠孚，無思不服，鑾光幸岱，匪暮斯朝。
units.en: Your imperial strategy reaches far and wins every heart; your sacred radiance will visit Mount Tai—not by evening but by morning.
units.literal: Your imperial strategy reaches far and wins trust; none who think on it fail to submit; the imperial radiance visits Mount Dai—not by evening but by morning.

units.zh: 臣請收籍伊瀍，茲書復掌，猶取之內府，藏之外，於理有愜，卽事何損。
units.en: I ask that we register the texts of the Yi and Luo and hold these books again ourselves—taken from our inner treasury and kept from them abroad—which is reasonable and in practice costs nothing.
units.literal: Your subject requests to gather and register the Yi and Luo texts, that these books be held again in our keeping—still taking them from the inner treasury, storing them without—this accords with reason and in practice harms nothing.

units.zh: 若狂言足採，請決敕施行。
units.en: If this rash speech is worth heeding, I beg Your Majesty to decree and execute it.
units.literal: If this mad talk is worth adopting, I beg that an edict be decided and carried out.

units.zh: 世祖答曰：「吾意不異卿。
units.en: Emperor Wu replied, "My view is no different from yours.
units.literal: Emperor Wu replied: "My intent does not differ from yours.

units.zh: 今所啓，比相見更委悉。」
units.en: What you now present is fuller than when we spoke face to face."
units.literal: What you now present is more detailed than when we met in person."

units.zh: 事竟不行。
units.en: In the end nothing was done.
units.literal: In the end the matter was not carried out.

units.zh: 永明末，世祖欲北伐，使毛惠秀畫《漢武北伐圖》，使融掌其事。
units.en: At the end of the Yongming era Emperor Wu planned a northern campaign and commissioned Mao Huixiu to paint "Emperor Wu of Han's Northern Expedition," putting Rong in charge of the project.
units.literal: At the end of the Yongming era Emperor Wu wished to campaign north and had Mao Huixiu paint "Emperor Wu of Han's Northern Campaign"; he put Rong in charge of the matter.

units.zh: 融好功名，因此上疏曰：
units.en: Rong craved fame and used the occasion to submit a memorial:
units.literal: Rong loved fame and achievement and therefore submitted a memorial, saying:

units.zh: :　　臣聞情慉自中，事符則感，象構於始，機動斯彰。
units.en: I have heard that feeling wells up within, and when events accord it stirs response; images are shaped at the outset, and when the mechanism moves they appear.
units.literal: Your subject has heard that feeling stored within the heart, when affairs accord then moves the response; images are constructed at the beginning, and when the mechanism stirs they are displayed.

units.zh: 莊敬之道可宗，會揖讓其彌肅，勇烈之士足貴，應鼙鐸以增思。
units.en: The way of dignity and reverence deserves honor; at gatherings bowing and yielding grow more solemn still; brave men are precious, and answering to drums and bells deepens one's thought.
units.literal: The way of dignity and reverence may be honored; at gatherings bowing and yielding grow all the more solemn; brave and fierce men are fully to be prized—responding to drums and bells increases reflection.

units.zh: 肇植生民，厥詳旣緬，降及興運，維道有徵，莫不有所因循而升皇業者也。
units.en: From the first planting of humankind the record was already remote; down to ages of rising fortune the Way left its traces—none failed to build on precedent and ascend to imperial greatness.
units.literal: From the first planting of the people its details were already remote; descending to ages of flourishing fortune, only the Way had signs—none failed to follow something and ascend to imperial enterprise.

units.zh: 若夫膏腴旣稱，天乙知五方之富，皮幣已列，帝劉測四海之尊。
units.en: When fertile lands were acclaimed, Tianyi knew the wealth of the five directions; when furs and coin were set out, Emperor Liu measured the honor of the four seas.
units.literal: As for fertile lands already acclaimed, Tianyi knew the wealth of the five directions; fur and coin already arrayed, Emperor Liu gauged the honor of the four seas.

units.zh: 異封禪之文，則升中之典攸鬯，嘆輿地之圖，乃席卷之庸是立。
units.en: Unlike the texts of the feng and shan rites, the ceremony of ascending the central peak was thereby enriched; lamenting the map of the realm, the merit of sweeping it up in conquest was established.
units.literal: Differing from the feng and shan texts, then the rite of ascending the central peak was thereby enriched; sighing over the map of the realm's terrain, then the merit of rolling it up in a scroll was established.

units.zh: :　　伏惟陛下窮神盡聖，總極居中，偶化兩儀，均明二耀，拯玄綱於頹絕，反至道於澆淳，可謂區宇儀形，齊民先覺者也。
units.en: I consider that Your Majesty exhausts spirit and fulfills sagehood, holds the ultimate center, pairs with heaven and earth, balances sun and moon, rescues the cosmic order from collapse and returns the Way from vulgar decline—you are the model of the realm and guide to the people.
units.literal: Bowingly considering that Your Majesty exhausts spirit and fulfills sagehood, holds the ultimate center, pairs transformation with the Two Modes, balances brightness of the two luminaries, rescues the dark net from collapse, returns the utmost Way from shallow vulgarity—you may be called the model form of the realm, the foreknowing guide of the people.

units.zh: 臣亦遭逢，生此嘉運，鑿飲耕食，自幸唐年。
units.en: I too have met with fortune, born in this excellent age, drinking from the plow and eating from the soil, counting myself blessed to live in an age like Tang Yao's.
units.literal: Your subject too has met with fortune, born in this excellent age, drinking from the plow and eating from the field, counting himself blessed in the years of Tang.

units.zh: 而識用昏霾，經術疏淺，將薖且軸，豈蕨與薇。
units.en: Yet my mind is dim and my learning shallow; I am like artemisia about to wither on its stem—how could I compare to fern and orchid?
units.literal: Yet my knowledge and use are dim as haze, classical learning shallow and thin—I am about to wither like artemisia on its stem; how could I be fern and orchid?

units.zh: 皇鑒燭幽，天高聽下，賞片言之或善，矜一物之失時，湔拂塵蒙，霑飾光價，拔足草廬，廁身朝序，復得拜賀歲時，瞻望日月，於臣心願，曾已畢矣。
units.en: Your mirror illuminates the dark, heaven high yet hears below, rewarding a word if it has merit, pitying a talent mistimed, washing away dust and granting honor, lifting me from a grass hut into the court ranks, letting me again bow at the seasons and gaze on sun and moon—in my heart that wish was already fulfilled.
units.literal: The imperial mirror illuminates the dark, heaven is high yet hears below, rewarding a fragment of speech if perhaps good, pitying a single thing's untimely loss, washing away dust and mist, touching and adorning with light and price, pulling feet from the grass hut and placing body in court order, again able to bow in congratulation at the seasons and gaze upon sun and moon—in your subject's heart the wish was already fulfilled.

units.zh: 但千祀一逢，休明難再，思策鈆駑，樂陳涓壒。
units.en: Yet an age like this comes once in a thousand years and cannot be repeated; I mean to spur my feeble talent and gladly offer whatever small service I can.
units.literal: Yet a thousand years meet such brilliance but once, and this excellent clarity is hard to regain—I think to spur my leaden nag and gladly offer my tiny mound of dust.

units.zh: 竊習戰陣攻守之術，農桑牧藝之書，申、商、韓、墨之權，伊、周、孔、孟之道。
units.en: I have studied the arts of attack and defense, books of farming and herding, the stratagems of Shen Buhai, Shang Yang, Han Fei, and Mozi, and the Ways of Yi Yin, the Duke of Zhou, Confucius, and Mencius.
units.literal: Secretly I have studied the arts of battle array attack and defense, books of farming, sericulture, herding, and crafts, the stratagems of Shen, Shang, Han, and Mo, the Ways of Yi, Zhou, Confucius, and Mencius.

units.zh: 常願待詔朱闕，俯對青蒲，請閑宴之私，談當世之務。
units.en: I have long wished to await your summons at the vermilion gate, kneel before the green rush mats, and in a private audience discuss the affairs of the age.
units.literal: I constantly wish to await edict at the vermilion gate, bow facing the green rush mats, request the privacy of a leisurely banquet, and discuss the affairs of the age.

units.zh: 位賤人微，徒深傾款。
units.en: My rank is low and my person slight; I can only offer my deepest devotion.
units.literal: My rank is low and my person slight—I can only pour out deep devotion.

units.zh: :　　方今九服清怡，三靈和晏，木有附枝，輪無異轍，東鞮獻舞，南辮傳歌，羗、踰山，秦、屠越海，舌象翫委體之懃，輶譯厭瞻巡之數，固將開桂林於鳳山，創金城於西守。
units.en: Today the nine domains are tranquil, heaven, earth, and man are at peace; trees flourish and wheels run true; the eastern tribes present dance, the southern tribes send song; Qiang and Di cross mountains, Qin and Yue span seas; interpreters grow weary of foreign envoys' obeisance, translators tire of imperial tours—we shall surely open Guilin at Phoenix Mountain and build Golden City in the west.
units.literal: Now the nine domains are clear and at ease, the three numina harmonious and tranquil; trees have attached branches, wheels no differing tracks; the eastern Di present dance, the southern Man transmit song; Qiang and Di cross mountains, Qin and Yue span seas; interpreters weary of the diligence of those laying down their persons, relay-translators sated with the count of inspections—surely we shall open Guilin at Phoenix Mountain and found Golden City at the western guard.

units.zh: 而蠢爾獯狄，敢讎大邦，假息關河，竊命函谷，淪故京之爽塏，變舊邑而荒涼，息反坫之儒衣，久伊川之被髮。
units.en: Yet these stupid Xun and Di dare oppose the great state, clinging to life at the passes and rivers, stealing authority at Hangu, sinking the bright terraces of the old capital, turning ancient cities to desolation, silencing the scholar's robe at the ritual stand, and leaving Yi River long in disheveled hair.
units.literal: Yet these stupid Xiongnu and Di dare make enemy of the great state, borrowing breath at the passes and rivers, stealing mandate at Hangu, sinking the old capital's bright terraces, changing old cities to desolation, ceasing the scholar's robe returned to the altar, long wearing disheveled hair at the Yi River.

units.zh: 北地殘氓，東都遺老，莫不茹泣吞悲，傾耳戴目，翹心仁政，延首王風。
units.en: The remnant people of the north, the old elders of the Eastern Capital—all swallow tears, strain their ears and eyes, yearn for benevolent rule, and stretch their necks for the royal transforming wind.
units.literal: The remnant people of the northern lands, the old elders of the Eastern Capital—none fail to swallow tears and grief, incline ears and lift eyes, crane hearts toward benevolent government, stretch necks for royal wind.

units.zh: 若試馳咫尺之書，具甄戎旅之卒，徇其墮城，納其降虜，可弗勞弦鏃，無待干戈。
units.en: If we send a letter a few inches long and muster our troops, accept their fallen cities and their surrendering captives, we need not strain bowstrings or wait for battle.
units.literal: If we try sending a letter of a few inches, fully selecting army troops, following their fallen cities and receiving their surrendering captives—we need not weary bowstrings and arrows, nor wait for weapons of war.

units.zh: 真皇王之兵，征而不戰者也。
units.en: That is the army of a true sage-king—one that campaigns without fighting.
units.literal: This is truly the army of a sage-king—campaigning without fighting.

units.zh: 臣乞以執殳先邁，式道中原，澄澣渚之恒流，掃狼山之積霧，係單于之頸，屈左賢之膝，習呼韓之舊儀，拜鑾輿之巡幸。
units.en: I beg to take spear in hand and march ahead, open the way through the Central Plains, clear the constant streams, sweep the mists from Wolf Mountain, bind the Chanyu's neck, bend the Left Worthy's knee, restore the old rites of Huhanye, and bow when your imperial carriage tours the north.
units.literal: Your subject begs to take spear in hand and advance first, open the way through the Central Plains, clarify the constant flow of the washing ford, sweep the piled mists of Wolf Mountain, bind the Chanyu's neck, bend the Left Worthy's knee, practice the old rites of Huhanye, and bow at the imperial carriage's tour of inspection.

units.zh: 然後天移雲動，勒封岱宗，咸五登三，追蹤七十，百神肅警，萬國具僚，璯弁星離，玉帛雲聚，集三燭於蘭席，聆萬歲之禎聲，豈不盛哉！
units.en: Then heaven will shift and clouds will move; we shall inscribe the feng on Mount Tai, complete the five rites and ascend the three, follow the seventy-two kings of old, the hundred spirits will stand in awe, the ten thousand states will attend as officials, jade caps will scatter like stars, jade and silk will gather like clouds, triple candles will burn on orchid mats, and we shall hear the auspicious cry of ten thousand years—how grand!
units.literal: Then heaven shifts and clouds move; we inscribe feng on Mount Dai, complete the five and ascend the three, follow the trail of seventy, the hundred spirits solemnly alert, the ten thousand states all as officials, jade caps star-scattered, jade and silk cloud-gathered, gathering triple candles on orchid mats, hearing the auspicious sound of ten thousand years—how is it not grand!

units.zh: 豈不韙哉！
units.en: How fitting!
units.literal: How is it not right!

units.zh: :　　昔桓公志在伐莒，郭牙審其幽趣，魏后心存去漢，德祖究其深言。
units.en: When Duke Huan of Qi meant to attack Ju, Guo Ya read his hidden intent; when the Wei empress meant to remove Han, Dezhi (Yang Xiu) plumbed her deeper meaning.
units.literal: Formerly Duke Huan's will was set on attacking Ju, and Guo Ya discerned his hidden intent; the Wei empress harbored thoughts of removing Han, and Dezhi plumbed her deep words.

units.zh: 臣愚昧，忖誠不足以知微，然伏揆聖心，規模弘遠，旣圖載其事，必克就其功。
units.en: I am foolish and my sincerity is not enough to grasp subtleties, yet I bow to your sacred intent—its scope is vast and far; since you have set this matter down in a picture, you will surely bring it to completion.
units.literal: Your subject is foolish and dull; sincere reckoning is insufficient to know subtleties—yet bowing to gauge the sacred heart, its scope is vast and far; since you have pictured and recorded this affair, you will surely be able to complete its achievement.

units.zh: 臣不勝歡喜。
units.en: I cannot contain my joy.
units.literal: Your subject cannot overcome his joy.

units.zh: 圖成，上置琅邪城射堂壁上，遊幸輙觀視焉。
units.en: When the painting was finished, the emperor hung it on the wall of the archery hall in Langya; on his tours he always stopped to view it.
units.literal: When the painting was finished, the Emperor placed it on the wall of the archery hall in Langya city; on his tours he would always view it.

units.zh: 九年，上幸芳林園禊宴朝臣，使融爲《曲水詩序》，文藻富麗，當世稱之。
units.en: In the ninth year the emperor held the spring purification feast for his ministers at Fanglin Garden and had Rong write the "Preface to the Winding Water Poems"; its prose was rich and splendid, and contemporaries praised it.
units.literal: In the ninth year the Emperor visited Fanglin Garden for the spring purification feast with his courtiers and had Rong compose the "Preface to the Winding Water Poems"; the literary ornament was rich and beautiful, and the age praised it.

units.zh: 上以融才辯，十一年，使兼主客，接虜使房景高、宋弁。
units.en: Because the emperor valued Rong's eloquence, in the eleventh year he made him also Director of Guests to receive the Northern Wei envoys Fang Jinggao and Song Bian.
units.literal: Because the Emperor valued Rong's talent and eloquence, in the eleventh year he had him additionally serve as Director of Guests and receive the barbarian envoys Fang Jinggao and Song Bian.

units.zh: 弁見融年少，問主客年幾？
units.en: Bian saw that Rong was young and asked how old the Director of Guests was.
units.literal: Bian saw that Rong was young and asked how old the Director of Guests was.

units.zh: 融曰：「五十之年，久踰其半。」
units.en: Rong said, "Of fifty years, I have long since passed the halfway mark."
units.literal: Rong said: "Of fifty years, I have long passed the half."

units.zh: 因問：「在朝聞主客作《曲水詩序》。」
units.en: He then asked, "At court I heard that the Director of Guests wrote the 'Preface to the Winding Water Poems.'"
units.literal: He then asked: "At court I heard that the Director of Guests composed the 'Preface to the Winding Water Poems.'"

units.zh: 景高又云：「在北聞主客此制，勝於顏延年，實願一見。」
units.en: Jinggao added, "In the north I heard that the Director of Guests wrote this piece, surpassing Yan Yanzhi—I would truly like to see it."
units.literal: Jinggao also said: "In the north I heard that the Director of Guests composed this piece, surpassing Yan Yanzhi—I truly wish to see it."

units.zh: 融乃示之。
units.en: Rong then showed it to him.
units.literal: Rong then showed it to him.

units.zh: 後日，宋弁於瑤池堂謂融曰：「昔觀相如《封禪》，以知漢武之德；
units.en: A few days later Song Bian said to Rong at Yaochi Hall, "When I once read Sima Xiangru's 'Feng and Shan,' I learned Emperor Wu of Han's virtue;
units.literal: Some days later, Song Bian at Yaochi Hall said to Rong: "Formerly, reading Sima Xiangru's 'Feng and Shan,' I came to know Emperor Wu of Han's virtue;

units.zh: 今覽王生《詩序》，用見齊王之盛。」
units.en: now reading your 'Poem Preface,' I see the splendor of the Prince of Qi."
units.literal: now reading Master Wang's 'Poem Preface,' thereby I see the Prince of Qi's splendor."

units.zh: 融曰：「皇家盛明，豈直比蹤漢武；
units.en: Rong said, "The imperial house is radiant—how could it be compared only with Emperor Wu of Han;
units.literal: Rong said: "The imperial house is splendid and bright—how could it merely be compared in trace to Emperor Wu of Han;

units.zh: 更慚鄙製，無以遠匹相如。」
units.en: and I am ashamed that my humble piece cannot remotely match Xiangru."
units.literal: I am all the more ashamed of my base composition, unable to match Xiangru from afar."

units.zh: 上以虜獻馬不稱，使融問曰：「秦西冀北，實多駿驥。
units.en: Because the horses the barbarians presented were unworthy, the emperor had Rong ask, "West of Qin and north of Ji have many fine steeds.
units.literal: Because the barbarians' presented horses were unworthy, the Emperor had Rong ask: "West of Qin and north of Ji truly have many fine steeds.

units.zh: 而魏主所獻良馬，乃駑駘之不若。
units.en: Yet the fine horses your Wei ruler presented are worse than common nags.
units.literal: Yet the fine horses presented by the Wei ruler are not even equal to nags.

units.zh: 求名檢事，殊爲未孚。
units.en: To seek a good name while the facts fail to match is hardly convincing.
units.literal: Seeking reputation while checking the facts, this is especially unconvincing.

units.zh: 將旦旦信誓，有時而爽，駉駉之牧，不能復嗣？」
units.en: Will sworn faith given morning after morning sometimes be broken, and the sleek herds never be matched again?"
units.literal: Will daily sworn faith at times be broken, and the herds of sleek horses not be succeeded again?"

units.zh: 宋弁曰：「不容虛偽之名，當是不習土地。」
units.en: Song Bian said, "A false reputation will not stand—probably they are unaccustomed to the terrain here."
units.literal: Song Bian said: "It cannot bear a false reputation—probably they are unaccustomed to the terrain."

units.zh: 融曰：「周穆馬迹徧於天下，若騏驥之性，因地而遷，則造父之策，有時而躓。」
units.en: Rong said, "King Mu of Zhou's horses ranged over all the world; if fine steeds change with the land, then even Zaofu's skill would sometimes fail."
units.literal: Rong said: "King Mu of Zhou's horse tracks ranged over all under heaven; if the nature of qiji steeds shifts with the land, then Zaofu's strategies would sometimes stumble."

units.zh: 弁曰：「王主客何爲懃懃於千里？」
units.en: Bian said, "Why is Director Wang so eager about a thousand-li horse?"
units.literal: Bian said: "Why is Director Wang so earnest about a thousand li?"

units.zh: 融曰：「卿國旣異其優劣，聊復相訪。
units.en: Rong said, "Since your state already admits they differ in quality, I am simply asking again.
units.literal: Rong said: "Your state already differs in their excellence and inferiority—I merely inquire again.

units.zh: 若千里日至，聖上當駕鼓車。」
units.en: If a thousand-li horse arrives within a day, the emperor will drive the drum carriage to meet it."
units.literal: If a thousand-li horse arrives within the day, the Sage Emperor will drive the drum carriage."

units.zh: 弁曰：「向意旣須，必不能駕鼓車也。」
units.en: Bian said, "Since you already wanted one, he surely will not drive the drum carriage."
units.literal: Bian said: "Since the intent was already required, he surely cannot drive the drum carriage."

units.zh: 融曰：「買死馬之骨，亦以郭隗之故。」
units.en: Rong said, "Buying the bones of a dead horse was also for Guo Wei's sake."
units.literal: Rong said: "Buying the bones of a dead horse was also because of Guo Wei."

units.zh: 弁不能答。
units.en: Bian had no answer.
units.literal: Bian could not reply.

units.zh: 融自恃人地，三十內望爲公輔。
units.en: Rong trusted in his birth and standing and expected to reach the highest ministerial rank before he was thirty.
units.literal: Rong relied on his person and place, expecting within thirty years to become a minister at the highest level.

units.zh: 直中書省，夜歎曰：「鄧禹笑人。」
units.en: One night at the Secretariat he sighed, "Deng Yu would laugh at me."
units.literal: While at the Secretariat he sighed at night: "Deng Yu would laugh at me."

units.zh: 行逢大開，喧湫不得進。
units.en: On his way he met a great throng, noisy and jammed, and could not pass.
units.literal: Walking he met a great opening, noisy and crowded, unable to advance.

units.zh: 又歎曰：「車前無八騶卒，何得稱爲丈夫！」
units.en: He sighed again, "With no eight outriders before my carriage, how can I call myself a man!"
units.literal: He sighed again: "With no eight outriders before my carriage, how can I be called a true man!"

units.zh: 朝廷討雍州刺史王奐，融復上疏曰：
units.en: When the court moved against Wang Huan, Governor of Yong Province, Rong submitted another memorial:
units.literal: When the court campaigned against Wang Huan, Governor of Yong Province, Rong again submitted a memorial, saying:

units.zh: :　　臣每覽史傳，見憂國忘家，捐生報德者，未曾不撫卷歎息，以爲今古共情也。
units.en: Whenever I read the histories and see men who forgot their families for the state and gave their lives to repay kindness, I cannot help stroking the scroll and sighing, for I believe past and present share the same feeling.
units.literal: Your subject whenever reads historical records and sees those who worry for the state and forget family, who give life to repay kindness—never fails to stroke the scroll and sigh, thinking this is feeling shared by past and present.

units.zh: 然或以片言微感，一餐小惠，參國士之眄，同布素之遊耳。
units.en: Yet some were moved by a single word or a meal's small favor, earning a great man's glance or sharing a commoner's friendship—that is all.
units.literal: Yet some were moved by a fragment of speech or a slight favor at one meal, joining a national scholar's glance or sharing a plain-cloth friend's company—that is all.

units.zh: 豈有如臣，獨拔無聞之伍，過超非分之位，名器雙假，榮祿兩升，而宴安具罷之晨，優游旰食之日。
units.en: How could there be one like me, plucked alone from obscurity, raised beyond my deserts, given both title and regalia, both honor and salary—yet living at ease while the ruler eats late into the day?
units.literal: How could there be one like your subject, alone plucked from the ranks of the unheard-of, surpassing a position beyond his measure, name and regalia doubly lent, honor and salary doubly raised—yet on mornings when feasting and ease are fully done, on days of leisurely ease while the ruler eats late?

units.zh: 所以敢布丹愚，仰聞宸聽。
units.en: That is why I dare offer my loyal counsel and beg to be heard by the throne.
units.literal: Therefore I dare lay out my red sincerity and look up to be heard by the imperial ear.

units.zh: :　　今議者或以西夏爲念，臣竊謂之不爾。
units.en: Some advisers now worry about the western campaign; I do not think they should.
units.literal: Now those who deliberate sometimes take the western Xia frontier as their concern; your subject privately thinks it is not so.

units.zh: 其故何哉？
units.en: Why?
units.literal: What is the reason?

units.zh: 陛下聖明，羣臣悉力，從以制逆，上而御下，指開賞黜之言，微示生死之路，方域之人，皆相爲敵。
units.en: Your Majesty is sage and bright, your ministers give their full strength, rebellion is controlled from above, reward and punishment are made plain and the path of life and death shown—the people of the region have turned against one another.
units.literal: Your Majesty is sage and bright, the ministers all exert their strength, following to control rebellion, governing above and mastering below, pointing to open words of reward and punishment, subtly showing the path of life and death—the people of the region all become one another's enemies.

units.zh: 旣兵威遠臨，人不自保，雖窮鳥必啄，固等命於梁鶉，困獸斯驚，終竝懸於廚鹿。
units.en: Once your armies press near, no one can protect himself; cornered birds must strike, beasts in a trap panic, and in the end they will all hang together like deer in the kitchen.
units.literal: Since military might reaches from afar, men cannot preserve themselves; though a cornered bird must peck, they are alike in fate to the beam quail; a trapped beast is startled, and in the end all hang together like kitchen deer.

units.zh: 凱師勞飲，固不待晨。
units.en: The victory feast need not wait until morning.
units.literal: A victorious army's labor and drinking surely need not wait for morning.

units.zh: 臣之寸心，獨有微願。
units.en: In my heart I have only one small wish.
units.literal: Your subject's inch of heart has only a slight wish.

units.zh: :　　自獫狁荐食，荒侮伊瀍，天道禍淫，危亡日至，母后內難，糧力外虛，謠言物情，屬當今會。
units.en: Since the barbarians have repeatedly encroached and insulted the heartland, heaven punishes excess and ruin draws near daily; the empress dowager faces internal trouble, supplies abroad are exhausted, and rumor and popular feeling all point to this moment.
units.literal: Since the Xianyun have repeatedly encroached, wildly insulting the Yi and Luo, heaven's way punishes excess and peril and ruin arrive daily; the empress dowager has internal troubles, grain and strength are empty abroad, rumors and popular feeling—all belong to the present moment.

units.zh: 若藉巫、漢之歸師，騁士卒之餘憤，取函谷如反掌，陵關塞若摧枯。
units.en: If we use the returning armies of Wu and Han and unleash the soldiers' remaining fury, we could take Hangu Pass as easily as turning one's hand and storm the frontier barriers as if crushing dry wood—
units.literal: If we borrow the returning armies of Wu and Han, unleash the soldiers' remaining fury, taking Hangu as if turning the hand, storming passes and barriers as if crushing dry wood—

units.zh: 但士非素蓄，無以卽用，不教民戰，是實棄之。
units.en: but the troops are not long trained and cannot be used at once; not to teach the people war is truly to abandon them.
units.literal: but the troops are not long trained and cannot be used at once; not to teach the people war is truly to abandon them.

units.zh: 特希私集部曲，豫加習校。
units.en: I beg only to gather my private retainers in advance and train them.
units.literal: I especially hope to gather my private retainers in advance and add drill and training.

units.zh: 若蒙垂許，乞隷監省拘食人身，權備石頭防衞之數。
units.en: If you grant this, I ask to be attached to the supervisory offices for rations and temporarily to fill the Stone City defense quota.
units.literal: If I receive gracious permission, I beg to be attached to the supervisory offices for rationed provisions, temporarily filling the Stone City defense quota.

units.zh: 臣少重名節，早習軍旅，若試而無績，伏受面欺之誅；
units.en: From youth I have valued honor and early studied military affairs; if tried and I fail, I accept punishment for deceiving you to your face;
units.literal: Your subject from youth valued reputation and integrity and early studied military affairs; if tried and without achievement, I bow to accept punishment for deceiving you to your face;

units.zh: 用且有功，仰詶知人之哲。
units.en: if employed and I succeed, I will repay your wisdom in knowing men.
units.literal: if employed and with achievement, I look up to repay the wisdom of knowing men.

units.zh: 會虜動，竟陵王子良於東府募人，板融寧朔將軍、軍主。
units.en: When the barbarians stirred, the Prince of Jingling recruited men at the Eastern Mansion and appointed Rong General Who Pacifies the North and army commander.
units.literal: When the barbarians stirred, the Prince of Jingling Ziliang recruited men at the Eastern Mansion and appointed Rong General Who Pacifies the North and Army Commander.

units.zh: 融文辭辯捷，尤善倉卒屬綴，有所造作，援筆可待。
units.en: Rong was eloquent and quick with words, especially skilled at composing on the spur of the moment—whatever he wrote, he could take up the brush and finish at once.
units.literal: Rong's literary style was eloquent and quick; he was especially skilled at composing on the spur of the moment—whatever he wrote, he could take up the brush and wait no longer.

units.zh: 子良特相友好，情分殊常。
units.en: Ziliang was especially close to him; their bond was unlike any other.
units.literal: Ziliang was especially friendly with him; their bond was unlike the ordinary.

units.zh: 晚節大習騎馬。
units.en: In his later years he trained hard in horsemanship.
units.literal: In his later years he greatly practiced horsemanship.

units.zh: 才地旣華，兼藉子良之勢，傾意賔客，勞問周款，文武翕習輻湊之。
units.en: His talent and birth were already splendid, and with Ziliang's backing he lavished attention on guests; civil and military men flocked to him like spokes to a hub.
units.literal: His talent and standing being already splendid, and additionally relying on Ziliang's power, he poured out favor on guests, laboring in inquiry with full cordiality; civil and military men accustomed to him converged like wheel spokes.

units.zh: 招集江西傖楚數百人，竝有幹用。
units.en: He recruited several hundred tough men from Jiangxi and Chu, all capable and useful.
units.literal: He recruited several hundred Jiangxi and Chu bondsmen, all capable and useful.

units.zh: 世祖疾篤暫絕，子良在殿內，太孫未入，融戎服絳衫，於中書省閤口斷東宮仗不得進，欲立子良。
units.en: When Emperor Wu was gravely ill and briefly lost consciousness, Ziliang was in the hall and the heir apparent had not yet entered; Rong in military dress and scarlet shirt blocked the Eastern Palace guards at the Secretariat gate, intending to make Ziliang emperor.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu was gravely ill and briefly lost consciousness, Ziliang was inside the hall and the Heir Apparent had not yet entered; Rong in military dress and scarlet shirt at the Secretariat gate cut off the Eastern Palace guards from entering, wishing to establish Ziliang.

units.zh: 上旣蘇，太孫入殿，朝事委高宗。
units.en: When the emperor revived, the heir apparent entered the hall and court affairs were entrusted to the High Ancestor Xiao Luan.
units.literal: When the Emperor revived, the Heir Apparent entered the hall and court affairs were entrusted to the High Ancestor.

units.zh: 融知子良不得立，乃釋服還省。
units.en: Rong knew Ziliang could not take the throne, removed his military dress, and returned to his office.
units.literal: Rong knew Ziliang could not be established and then removed his military dress and returned to his office.

units.zh: 歎曰：「公誤我。」
units.en: He sighed, "You misled me."
units.literal: He sighed: "My lord misled me."

units.zh: 鬱林深忿疾融，卽位十餘日，收下廷尉獄，然後使中丞孔稚珪倚爲奏曰：「融姿性剛險，立身浮競，動迹驚羣，抗言異類。
units.en: Emperor Yulin deeply hated Rong; within a fortnight of his accession he had Rong imprisoned by the Minister of Justice, then had Censor Kong Zhigui draft the charge: "Rong's nature is harsh and treacherous, his conduct restless and competitive; his actions alarm the court and his words oppose his peers.
units.literal: Emperor Yulin deeply resented Rong; within ten-odd days of his accession he had him taken to the Minister of Justice prison, then had Censor Kong Zhigui draft the accusation, saying: "Rong's nature is harsh and dangerous, his conduct floating and competitive; his movements startle the crowd and his words oppose his kind.

units.zh: 近塞外微塵，苦求將領，遂招納不逞，扇誘荒傖。
units.en: When slight trouble stirred beyond the frontier he eagerly sought command and recruited unruly men, stirring up wild bondsmen.
units.literal: Recently beyond the frontier slight dust stirred; he bitterly sought commanders and thus recruited unruly men, inciting and seducing wild bondsmen.

units.zh: 狡筭聲勢，專行權利，反覆脣齒之閒，傾動頰舌之內。
units.en: He cunningly built his reputation, monopolized power, and with words back and forth stirred up trouble within the court.
units.literal: Cunning in calculating reputation, monopolizing power and profit, turning back and forth between lips and teeth, overturning within cheeks and tongues.

units.zh: 威福自己，無所忌憚，誹謗朝政，歷毀王公，謂己才流，無所推下，事曝遠近，使融依源據答。」
units.en: He wielded power as he pleased, feared nothing, slandered the government, repeatedly defamed princes and dukes, and claimed no one matched his talent; when the matter became known far and wide, Rong was made to answer each charge in turn."
units.literal: Authority and blessing from himself, nothing feared or dreaded; slandering court governance, repeatedly defaming princes and dukes, claiming his talent flowed with none below him; the matter exposed near and far—he had Rong answer point by point according to the sources."

units.zh: 融辭曰：「囚寔頑蔽，觸行多諐，但夙忝門素，得奉教君子。
units.en: Rong replied, "I am truly dull and often err in conduct, yet from childhood I have disgraced a noble house and was taught by gentlemen.
units.literal: Rong replied: "The prisoner is truly stubborn and blind, and in conduct often errs; yet from old I have disgraced my family's standing and was able to receive instruction from gentlemen.

units.zh: 爰自總髮，迄將立年，州閭郷黨，見許愚慎，朝廷衣冠，謂無舋咎。
units.en: From childhood until near my coming of age, neighbors regarded me as cautious, and at court they said I had given no offense.
units.literal: From tying my hair until nearly the standing year, in district and village I was regarded as foolishly cautious; among court caps and robes they said I had no fault.

units.zh: 過蒙大行皇帝獎育之恩，又荷文皇帝識擢之重，司徒公賜預士林，安陸王曲垂眄接。
units.en: I received the late emperor's grace in nurturing me, again the late emperor's favor in promoting me; the Grand Minister admitted me to the scholars, and the Prince of Anlu showed me special regard.
units.literal: I excessively received the late emperor's grace in nurturing and fostering, again bore the late emperor's weight in recognizing and promoting me; the Grand Minister granted me place in the forest of scholars, the Prince of Anlu bent to bestow his glance and reception.

units.zh: 旣身被國慈，必欲以死自效，前後陳伐虜之計，亦仰簡先朝。
units.en: Having received the state's kindness, I wished to repay it with my life; again and again I presented plans against the barbarians, as the former court approved.
units.literal: Having received the state's kindness on my person, I surely wished to repay with death; before and after I presented plans for campaigning against the barbarians, also looking up to the former court's selection.

units.zh: 今假犬羊乍擾，紀僧真奉宣先敕，賜語北邊動靜，令囚草撰符詔，于時卽因啓聞，希侍鑾輿。
units.en: When the barbarians stirred, Ji Sengzhen announced the prior edict and told me of northern movements; I was ordered to draft edicts and at once memorialized, hoping to attend the imperial carriage.
units.literal: Now under pretense that dogs and sheep suddenly stirred, Ji Sengzhen announced the prior edict, bestowing words on northern movements; the prisoner was ordered to draft talisman edicts, and at that time through memorial sought to attend the imperial carriage.

units.zh: 及司徒宣敕招募，同例非一，實以戎事不小，不敢承教。
units.en: When the Grand Minister ordered recruitment, others were treated the same; truly because military affairs were grave, I did not dare refuse.
units.literal: When the Grand Minister announced an edict to recruit, there were not a few of the same category; truly because military affairs were not small, I did not dare accept the instruction.

units.zh: 續蒙軍號，賜使招集，銜敕而行，非敢虛扇。
units.en: I then received a military title and was ordered to recruit; I acted under edict and did not dare stir up trouble on my own.
units.literal: I continued to receive a military title and was granted commission to recruit; bearing the edict I acted—not daring to stir up emptily.

units.zh: 且格取亡叛，不限傖楚，『狡笇聲勢』，應有形迹。
units.en: Moreover, seizing fugitives and rebels was not limited to Chu men; 'cunning reputation-building' should leave visible traces.
units.literal: Moreover, seizing fugitives and rebels was not limited to Chu bondsmen; 'cunning in calculating reputation' should have visible traces.

units.zh: 『專行權利』，又無贓賄。
units.en: 'Monopolizing power'—again there is no bribery.
units.literal: 'Monopolizing power and profit'—again there is no bribe or theft.

units.zh: 『反覆脣齒之間』，未審悉與誰言？
units.en: 'Turning back and forth in words'—with whom exactly did I speak?
units.literal: 'Turning back and forth between lips and teeth'—I do not yet know fully with whom I spoke?

units.zh: 『傾動頰舌之內』，不容都無主此。
units.en: 'Stirring trouble within the court'—surely there must be witnesses.
units.literal: 'Overturning within cheeks and tongues'—it cannot be that there is altogether no master of this.

units.zh: 但聖主膺教，實所沐浴，自上《甘露頌》及《銀甕啓》、《三日詩序》、《接虜使語辭》，竭思稱揚，得非『誹謗』？
units.en: But I bathed in the sage ruler's teaching; from the 'Ode to Sweet Dew' and 'Silver Urn Memorial' to the 'Three-Day Poem Preface' and 'Words on Receiving Barbarian Envoys' I exhausted myself in praise—how is that 'slander'?
units.literal: But the sage ruler received the teaching—I truly bathed in it; from above the 'Ode to Sweet Dew' and 'Silver Urn Memorial,' the 'Three-Day Poem Preface,' and 'Words on Receiving Barbarian Envoys'—exhausting thought in praise—how could this be 'slander'?

units.zh: 且王公百司，唯賢是與，高下之敬，等秩有差，不敢踰濫，豈應『訾毀』？
units.en: Among princes and the hundred offices, only the worthy are advanced; ranks differ in honor—I did not dare overstep; how could I 'revile' them?
units.literal: Moreover, among princes, dukes, and the hundred offices, only the worthy are given place; respect high and low, ranks have differences—I did not dare exceed or overflow; how could I 'revile and destroy'?

units.zh: 囚才分本劣，謬被策用，悚怍之情，夙宵兢惕，未嘗誇示里閭，彰曝遠邇，自循自省，竝愧流言。
units.en: My talent was always inferior and I was wrongly employed; I have been fearful day and night, never boasting in my village or exposing myself far and wide; examining myself, I am ashamed of rumor.
units.literal: The prisoner's talent and share were originally inferior, wrongly selected for use; a fearful and ashamed feeling, from early to night vigilant and cautious—I never boasted to village and lane, exposed near and far; examining myself, I am together ashamed of floating words.

units.zh: 良由緣淺寡虞，致貽囂謗。
units.en: Truly because my ties were shallow and I lacked foresight, I brought clamor and slander upon myself.
units.literal: Truly because my ties were shallow and I lacked foresight, I caused clamorous slander to be left behind.

units.zh: 伏惟明皇臨宇，普天蒙澤，戊寅赦恩，輕重必宥。
units.en: I consider that the bright emperor rules the realm and all heaven receives his grace; the wuyin amnesty must pardon both light and heavy offenses.
units.literal: Bowingly considering that the bright emperor rules the realm, all heaven receives his grace; the wuyin amnesty, light and heavy must be pardoned.

units.zh: 百日曠期，始蒙旬日，一介罪身，獨嬰憲劾。
units.en: The hundred-day grace period had only just begun its ten-day window, yet I alone, a single guilty man, bear punishment.
units.literal: A hundred days of broad grace, I received only ten days at the start—a single body of guilt, alone bearing punishment.

units.zh: 若事實有徵，爰對有在，九死之日，無恨泉壤。」
units.en: If the facts are proved, answers can be given; on the day I die nine deaths over, I will have no regret in the grave."
units.literal: If the facts have proof, there are answers ready; on the day of nine deaths, I have no regret in the springs and soil."

units.zh: 詔於獄賜死。
units.en: An edict ordered him to die in prison.
units.literal: An edict granted death in prison.

units.zh: 時年二十七。
units.en: He was twenty-seven years old.
units.literal: He was then twenty-seven years old.

units.zh: 臨死歎曰：「我若不爲百歲老母，當吐一言。」
units.en: Facing death he sighed, "If it were not for my aged mother, I would speak one word."
units.literal: Facing death he sighed: "If it were not for my hundred-year-old mother, I would speak one word."

units.zh: 融意欲指斥帝在東宮時過失也。
units.en: Rong meant to denounce the emperor's misconduct when he was heir apparent.
units.literal: Rong meant to denounce the emperor's faults when he was in the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 融被收，朋友部曲參問北寺，相繼於道。
units.en: When Rong was arrested, friends and retainers came in succession to inquire at North Temple along the road.
units.literal: When Rong was arrested, friends and retainers came to inquire at North Temple, succeeding one another on the road.

units.zh: 融請救於子良，子良憂懼不敢救。
units.en: Rong begged Ziliang to save him, but Ziliang was too afraid to intervene.
units.literal: Rong begged Ziliang to save him; Ziliang was anxious and afraid and did not dare save him.

units.zh: 融文集行於世。
units.en: Rong's collected writings circulated in his time.
units.literal: Rong's collected writings circulated in the world.

units.zh: 謝朓
units.en: Xie Tiao
units.literal: Xie Tiao

units.zh: 謝朓字玄暉，陳郡陽夏人也。
units.en: Xie Tiao, whose style name was Xuanhui, came from Yangxia in Chen commandery.
units.literal: Xie Tiao, style name Xuanhui, was a native of Chen commandery in Yangxia.

units.zh: 祖述，吳興太守。
units.en: His grandfather Shu was Administrator of Wuxing.
units.literal: His grandfather Shu was Administrator of Wuxing.

units.zh: 父緯，散騎侍郎。
units.en: His father Wei was Attendant Gentleman of the Household.
units.literal: His father Wei was Attendant Gentleman of the Household.

units.zh: 朓少好學，有美名，文章清麗。
units.en: Tiao from youth loved learning, enjoyed a fine reputation, and wrote in a clear, beautiful style.
units.literal: Tiao from youth loved learning, had a fine reputation, and his writings were clear and beautiful.

units.zh: 解褐豫章王太尉行參軍，度隨王東中郎府，轉王儉衞軍東閤祭酒，太子舍人、隨王鎮西功曹，轉文學。
units.en: Upon entering office he was Acting Aide to the Prince of Yuzhang as Grand Minister, moved to the staff of the Prince of Sui as Eastern Commander-in-Chief, became Eastern Pavilion Libationer on Wang Jian's staff as Guard General, then Attendant of the Heir Apparent and Western Headquarters Aide to the Prince of Sui, and finally Literary Scholar.
units.literal: Upon leaving the cloth he was Acting Aide to the Prince of Yuzhang as Grand Minister, crossed to the Eastern Central Staff of the Prince of Sui, transferred to Wang Jian's Eastern Pavilion Libationer on the Guard General's staff, Attendant of the Heir Apparent and Western Headquarters Aide to the Prince of Sui, then transferred to Literary Scholar.

units.zh: 子隆在荊州，好辭賦，數集僚友，朓以文才，尤被賞愛，流連晤對，不捨日夕。
units.en: Zilong in Jing Province loved poetry and often gathered his staff; Tiao for his literary talent was especially favored, and they lingered in conversation day and night.
units.literal: Zilong in Jing Province loved rhapsodies and fu, often gathering staff and friends; Tiao for his literary talent was especially prized and loved, lingering in meetings day and night without parting.

units.zh: 長史王秀之以朓年少相動，密以啓聞。
units.en: Chief Aide Wang Xiuzhi, because Tiao was young and was exerting influence, secretly reported it to the throne.
units.literal: Chief Aide Wang Xiuzhi, because Tiao was young, suspected improper intimacy and secretly memorialized the court.

units.zh: 世祖敕曰：「侍讀虞雲自宜恒應侍接。
units.en: Emperor Wu ordered, "Reader-in-Waiting Yu Yun should constantly attend the prince.
units.literal: Emperor Wu ordered: "Reader-in-Waiting Yu Yun himself should constantly attend and receive him.

units.zh: 朓可還都。」
units.en: Tiao is to return to the capital."
units.literal: Tiao may return to the capital."

units.zh: 朓道中爲詩寄西府曰：「常恐鷹隼擊，秋菊委嚴霜。
units.en: On the road Tiao sent a poem to the western headquarters: "I constantly fear the hawk's strike; autumn chrysanthemums bow to harsh frost.
units.literal: On the road Tiao composed a poem sent to the western headquarters, saying: "I constantly fear the hawk and falcon's strike; autumn chrysanthemums yield to harsh frost.

units.zh: 寄言罻羅者，寥廓已高翔。」
units.en: Tell the fowler: in the vast sky I have already soared away."
units.literal: I send word to the net-setter: in the vast expanse I have already soared high."

units.zh: 遷新安王中軍記室。
units.en: He was transferred to Recorder of the Central Army on the staff of the Prince of Xin'an.
units.literal: He was transferred to Recorder of the Central Army under the Prince of Xin'an.

units.zh: 朓牋辭子隆曰：「朓聞潢汙之水，思朝宗而每竭；
units.en: Tiao wrote Zilong a farewell note: "I have heard that muddy pool water, though it longs to reach the great river, is always exhausted;
units.literal: Tiao in a note taking leave of Zilong said: "Tiao has heard that muddy pool water, thinking to pay court to the source, is each time exhausted;

units.zh: 駑蹇之乘，希沃若而中疲。
units.en: a lame nag's cart, hoping for lush pasture yet failing halfway.
units.literal: a lame nag's carriage, hoping for lush growth yet failing midway.

units.zh: 何則？
units.en: Why?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 皐壤搖落，對之惆悵；
units.en: The highland soil shakes and falls; facing it one is filled with melancholy;
units.literal: Highland soil shakes and falls; facing it one is melancholy;

units.zh: 岐路東西，或以嗚悒。
units.en: roads east and west—perhaps one sobs in distress.
units.literal: crossroads east and west—perhaps one sobs in distress.

units.zh: 況乃服義徒擁，歸志莫從，邈若墜雨，飄似秋蔕。
units.en: How much more when duty binds me though followers crowd round, and homeward will cannot be followed—distant as falling rain, drifting like an autumn stem.
units.literal: How much more when duty binds yet followers crowd, homeward will cannot be followed—distant as falling rain, drifting like an autumn stem.

units.zh: 朓實庸流，行能無算，屬天地休明，山川受納，褒採一介，搜揚小善，捨耒場圃，奉筆菟園。
units.en: I am truly a mediocrity, my conduct and ability beyond reckoning; heaven and earth were bright, mountains and rivers at peace; one man was praised and small merit sought out—I left the plow in the fields and took up the brush in the garden.
units.literal: Tiao is truly a mediocre current, conduct and ability beyond reckoning; it happened that heaven and earth were bright and restful, mountains and rivers received and accepted—praising and selecting one man, searching and raising small goodness, leaving the plow in field and garden, taking up the brush in the rabbit garden.

units.zh: 東亂三江，西浮七澤，契闊戎旃，從容讌語。
units.en: East through the turmoil of the three rivers, west across the seven marshes, parting and reuniting under military banners, at ease in feast and conversation.
units.literal: East through the turmoil of the three rivers, west floating the seven marshes, parting and reuniting under military banners, at ease in feast and talk.

units.zh: 長裾日曳，後乘載脂，榮立府廷，恩加顏色。
units.en: Long robes trailed day after day, rear carriages bore gifts; I stood honored in your court, and favor brightened my face.
units.literal: Long robes trailed day by day, rear carriages bore grease; honor stood in the prince's court, favor added to his countenance.

units.zh: 沐髮晞陽，未測涯涘；
units.en: I bathed my hair in the sun, never guessing where the shore lay;
units.literal: Washing hair in the drying sun, I had not measured the shore's limit;

units.zh: 撫臆論報，早誓肌骨。
units.en: I pressed my breast and spoke of repayment, swearing it early in flesh and bone.
units.literal: stroking my breast I spoke of repayment, early swearing it in flesh and bone.

units.zh: 不悟滄溟未運，波臣自蕩；
units.en: I did not see that the great sea had not yet stirred, and I swayed like a wave-subject;
units.literal: I did not realize the dark sea had not yet moved, and the wave-subject swayed of itself;

units.zh: 渤澥方春，旅翮先謝。
units.en: the Bohai was barely in spring, yet the traveler's wings already withered.
units.literal: the Bohai was just in spring, yet the traveler's wings first withered.

units.zh: 清切蕃房，寂寥舊蓽。
units.en: The clear, intimate lodging abroad, the lonely old thatched hut.
units.literal: The clear, intimate foreign lodging, the lonely old thatched hut.

units.zh: 輕舟反泝，弔影獨留，白雲在天，龍門不見。
units.en: A light boat turns back upstream; I mourn my shadow left alone—white clouds fill the sky, and Dragon Gate is out of sight.
units.literal: A light boat turns back upstream; I mourn my shadow left alone—white clouds are in the sky, Dragon Gate is not seen.

units.zh: 去德滋永，思德滋深。
units.en: The farther I am from your grace, the longer it seems; the more I think on it, the deeper my feeling.
units.literal: Departing from virtue grows ever longer; thinking on virtue grows ever deeper.

units.zh: 唯待青江可望，候歸艎於春渚；
units.en: I only wait until the green river comes in view, watching for your returning boat at the spring ford;
units.literal: I only wait until the green river can be seen, watching for the returning boat at the spring ford;

units.zh: 朱邸方開，效蓬心於秋實。
units.en: your vermilion mansion newly opens—I offer my humble heart as autumn fruit.
units.literal: the vermilion mansion newly opens—I offer my artemisia heart in autumn fruit.

units.zh: 如其簪履或存，衽席無改，雖復身填溝壑，猶望妻子知歸。
units.en: If your favor still remains and your seat is unchanged, though my body fill ditch and ravine, I still hope my wife and children know I would return.
units.literal: If your cap-pins and shoes perhaps remain, your mat and seat unchanged—though my body fill gullies and ravines, I still hope my wife and children know to return.

units.zh: 攬涕告辭，悲來橫集。」
units.en: Wiping tears I take my leave; grief comes and gathers over me."
units.literal: Wiping tears I take leave; grief comes and gathers across me."

units.zh: 尋以本官兼尚書殿中郎。
units.en: Soon he additionally served as Attendant Gentleman of the Palace Department while keeping his original post.
units.literal: Soon on his original post he additionally served as Attendant Gentleman of the Palace Department in the Ministry of State Affairs.

units.zh: 隆昌初，敕朓接北使，朓自以口訥，啓讓不當，不見許。
units.en: At the beginning of Longchang he was ordered to receive northern envoys; thinking his speech too slow, he memorialized that he was unfit, but the request was denied.
units.literal: At the beginning of Longchang an edict ordered Tiao to receive northern envoys; Tiao himself thought his speech slow and memorialized that he was unfit—the request was not granted.

units.zh: 高宗輔政，以朓爲驃騎諮議，領記室，掌霸府文筆。
units.en: When Gaozong assisted in government, he made Tiao adviser to the Cavalry General, concurrently heading the Record Office and managing the princely headquarters' writings.
units.literal: When the High Ancestor assisted in government, he made Tiao Counselor to the Rapid Cavalry General, heading the Recorder's office and managing the hegemon's mansion literary brush.

units.zh: 又掌中書詔誥，除祕書丞，未拜，仍轉中書郎。
units.en: He also managed Secretariat edicts; was appointed Secretary Assistant but never took office, and was transferred to Secretariat Gentleman.
units.literal: He also managed Secretariat edicts and proclamations; was appointed Secretary Assistant but did not assume the post, and was transferred to Secretariat Gentleman.

units.zh: 出爲宣城太守，以選復爲中書郎。
units.en: He went out as Administrator of Xuancheng, then through selection returned as Secretariat Gentleman.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of Xuancheng; through selection he returned as Secretariat Gentleman.

units.zh: 建武四年，出爲晉安王鎮北諮議、南東海太守，行南徐州事。
units.en: In the fourth year of Jianwu he served as Counselor to the Prince of Jin'an as Northern Commander-in-Chief and Administrator of Southern Donghai, acting for Southern Xuzhou.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jianwu he went out as Counselor to the Prince of Jin'an as Northern Commander-in-Chief and Administrator of Southern Donghai, acting for Southern Xuzhou affairs.

units.zh: 啓王敬則反謀，上甚嘉賞之。
units.en: He reported Wang Jingze's plot to rebel, and the emperor greatly praised him.
units.literal: He reported Wang Jingze's rebellion plot; the Emperor greatly praised and rewarded him.

units.zh: 遷尚書吏部郎。
units.en: He was promoted to Attendant Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: He was transferred to Attendant Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 朓上表三讓，中書疑朓官未及讓，以問祭酒沈約。
units.en: Tiao submitted three memorials declining the post; the Secretariat doubted whether his rank warranted declining and asked Libationer Shen Yue.
units.literal: Tiao submitted a memorial thrice declining; the Secretariat doubted whether Tiao's rank had not yet reached the point for declining, and asked Libationer Shen Yue.

units.zh: 約曰：「宋元嘉中，范曅讓吏部，朱脩之讓黃門，蔡興宗讓中書，竝三表詔答，具事宛然。
units.en: Yue said, "In Emperor Wen's Yuanjia era, Fan Ye declined the Ministry of Personnel, Zhu Xiuzhi the Yellow Gate, and Cai Xingzong the Secretariat—all submitted three memorials and received edict replies; the precedents are clear.
units.literal: Yue said: "In Yuanjia of Liu Song, Fan Ye declined the Ministry of Personnel, Zhu Xiuzhi declined the Yellow Gate, Cai Xingzong declined the Secretariat—all thrice memorialized with edict replies; the matters are perfectly clear.

units.zh: 近世小官不讓，遂成恒俗，恐此有乖讓意。
units.en: In recent times minor offices no longer decline, and that has become custom—I fear that misses the point of yielding.
units.literal: In recent times minor offices do not decline, and this has become constant custom—I fear this goes against the meaning of yielding.

units.zh: 王藍田、劉安西竝貴重，初自不讓，今豈可慕此不讓邪？
units.en: Wang Lantian and Liu Anxi were both eminent and at first did not decline—how can we now imitate their refusal to decline?
units.literal: Wang Lantian and Liu Anxi were both eminent and weighty and at first did not decline—how can one now admire this non-declining?

units.zh: 孫興公、孔顗竝讓記室，今豈可三署皆讓邪？
units.en: Sun Xinggong and Kong Yan both declined the recorder's post—how can one decline all three offices now?
units.literal: Sun Xinggong and Kong Yan both declined the recorder's post—how can one now decline all three offices?

units.zh: 謝吏部今授超階，讓別有意，豈關官之大小？
units.en: Xie of the Ministry is now promoted beyond his rank—his declining has its own meaning; what has that to do with the size of the office?
units.literal: Xie of the Ministry of Personnel now receives a rank beyond his step—his declining has a separate intent; how does it concern the office's size?

units.zh: 撝讓之美，本出人情。
units.en: The beauty of yielding springs from human feeling.
units.literal: The beauty of yielding and declining springs from human feeling.

units.zh: 若大官必讓，便與詣闕章表不異。
units.en: If high offices must always decline, it is no different from a formal memorial at the palace gate.
units.literal: If great offices must decline, it is no different from presenting a memorial at the palace gate.

units.zh: 例旣如此，謂都自非疑。」
units.en: Since the precedents are clear, I see no doubt at all."
units.literal: Since precedent is thus, I say altogether there is no doubt."

units.zh: 朓又啓讓，上優答不許。
units.en: Tiao memorialized again to decline; the emperor graciously refused.
units.literal: Tiao again memorialized to decline; the Emperor graciously replied and did not permit it.

units.zh: 朓善草隷，長五言詩，沈約常云「二百年來無此詩也」。
units.en: Tiao was skilled in cursive and clerical script and excelled at five-character verse; Shen Yue often said, "In two hundred years there has been no poetry like this."
units.literal: Tiao was skilled in cursive and clerical script and excelled at five-word poetry; Shen Yue often said, "In two hundred years there has been no poetry like this."

units.zh: 敬皇后遷祔山陵，朓撰哀策文，齊世莫有及者。
units.en: When the Respectful Empress was moved to the imperial tomb, Tiao composed the lamentation text, unmatched in the Qi age.
units.literal: When the Respectful Empress was moved to join the imperial tomb, Tiao composed the lamentation text; in the Qi age none could match him.

units.zh: 東昏失德，江祐欲立夏王寶玄，末更回惑，與弟祀密謂朓曰：「江夏年少輕脫，不堪負荷神器，不可復行廢立。
units.en: When Emperor Donghun lost virtue, Jiang You wished to make the Prince of Xia, Bao Xuan, emperor, but later wavered; he and his brother Si secretly told Tiao, "The Prince of Jiangxia is young and frivolous and cannot bear the throne; we cannot depose and establish again.
units.literal: When Emperor Donghun lost virtue, Jiang You wished to establish the Prince of Xia, Bao Xuan, but at the end wavered again; with his brother Si he secretly told Tiao: "The Prince of Jiangxia is young, frivolous, and light—he cannot bear the regalia of the divine vessel; we cannot again carry out deposition and establishment.

units.zh: 始安年長入纂，不乖物望。
units.en: The Prince of Shi'an is older and would succeed without going against popular expectation.
units.literal: The Prince of Shi'an is older in entering succession and does not go against popular expectation.

units.zh: 非以此要富貴，政是求安國家耳。」
units.en: We do not seek wealth and honor by this—we seek only the state's peace."
units.literal: It is not by this to seek wealth and honor—it is truly to seek the state's peace."

units.zh: 遙光又遣親人劉渢密致意於朓，欲以爲肺腑。
units.en: Yaoguang also sent his confidant Liu Hong to convey his intentions secretly to Tiao, wishing to make him an intimate ally.
units.literal: Yaoguang also sent his close man Liu Hong to convey intentions secretly to Tiao, wishing to make him a heart-and-belly confidant.

units.zh: 朓自以受恩高宗，非渢所言，不肯答。
units.en: Tiao considered that he owed his favor to the High Ancestor and would not accept what Hong said; he refused to reply.
units.literal: Tiao himself thought he had received favor from the High Ancestor and that Hong's words were not acceptable; he refused to reply.

units.zh: 少日，遙光以朓兼知衞尉事，朓懼見引，卽以祏等謀告左興盛，興盛不敢發言。
units.en: A few days later Yaoguang had Tiao additionally manage the affairs of the Commandant of Guards; fearing entanglement, Tiao reported Shi and the others' plot to Zuo Xingsheng, who did not dare speak.
units.literal: A few days later Yaoguang had Tiao additionally manage the affairs of the Commandant of Guards; Tiao feared being drawn in and at once reported Shi and the others' plot to Zuo Xingsheng, who did not dare speak out.

units.zh: 祏聞，以告遙光，遙光大怒，乃稱敕召朓，仍回車付廷尉，與徐孝嗣、祏、暄等連名啓誅朓曰：「謝朓資性險薄，大彰遠近。
units.en: Si heard and told Yaoguang, who was furious; summoning Tiao in the emperor's name, he turned him over to the Minister of Justice; with Xu Xiaosi, Si, Xuan, and others he jointly memorialized for Tiao's execution: "Xie Tiao's nature is treacherous and shallow, notorious far and near.
units.literal: Si heard and told Yaoguang; Yaoguang was greatly enraged, then in the emperor's name summoned Tiao, turned the carriage back and handed him to the Minister of Justice; with Xu Xiaosi, Si, Xuan, and others he jointly memorialized to execute Tiao, saying: "Xie Tiao's nature is dangerous and thin, greatly manifest near and far.

units.zh: 王敬則往構凶逆，微有誠效，自爾昇擢，超越倫伍。
units.en: Wang Jingze had plotted treason; Tiao's small service in exposing it won promotion beyond his peers.
units.literal: Wang Jingze formerly plotted treason; he had slight sincere effect, and from then was promoted beyond his rank and peers.

units.zh: 而谿壑無厭，著於觸事。
units.en: Yet his greed knew no limit, shown in everything he did.
units.literal: Yet ravines and gullies know no satiety, manifest in whatever he touches.

units.zh: 比遂扇動內外，處處姦說，妄貶乘輿，竊論宮禁，閒謗親賢，輕議朝宰，醜言異計，非可具聞。
