units.en: Recently he has stirred court and country, spreading treacherous talk everywhere, demeaning the throne, discussing palace secrets, slandering kin and worthies, and lightly attacking ministers—ugly words and strange schemes too numerous to list.
units.literal: Recently he has stirred inside and outside, everywhere treacherous speech, recklessly demeaning the imperial carriage, privately discussing palace prohibitions, idly slandering kin and worthies, lightly debating court ministers—ugly words and strange schemes not to be fully heard.

units.zh: 無君之心旣著，共棄之誅宜及。
units.en: His disloyal heart is already plain; the punishment of collective rejection should fall on him.
units.literal: His heart without a ruler is already manifest; the punishment of collective rejection should reach him.

units.zh: 臣等參議，宜下北里，肅正刑書。」
units.en: We jointly recommend that he be sent to prison and the penal code solemnly applied."
units.literal: Your subjects jointly deliberate: he should be sent to North Lane and the penal code solemnly applied."

units.zh: 詔：「公等啓事如此，朓資性輕險，久彰物議。
units.en: The edict read: "Your report is as stated; Tiao's nature is frivolous and dangerous and has long been notorious.
units.literal: An edict said: "Your report is thus; Tiao's nature is light and dangerous, long manifest in public discussion.

units.zh: 直以彫蟲薄伎，見齒衣冠。
units.en: He was admitted to the ranks of officials only for his petty literary skill.
units.literal: Merely because of carving-insect petty skill he was counted among caps and robes.

units.zh: 昔在渚宮，構扇蕃邸，日夜縱諛，仰窺俯畫。
units.en: Formerly at the Isle Palace he stirred up the prince's household, flattering day and night, spying above and plotting below.
units.literal: Formerly at the Isle Palace he plotted and fanned the prince's mansion, day and night indulging flattery, looking up to spy and looking down to scheme.

units.zh: 及還京師，飜自宣露，江、漢無波，以爲己功。
units.en: When he returned to the capital he boasted of it himself, claiming credit though the Yangzi and Han were calm.
units.literal: When he returned to the capital he turned and exposed it himself—the Yangzi and Han without waves he took as his own achievement.

units.zh: 素論於茲而盡，縉紳所以側目。
units.en: Public opinion ended there, which is why officials looked askance at him.
units.literal: Plain discussion ended here; that is why the girdled and sashed turned their eyes sidelong.

units.zh: 去夏之事，頗有微誠，賞擢曲加，踰邁倫序，感悅未聞，陵競彌著。
units.en: Last summer's affair showed some small loyalty, and reward was bent to promote him beyond his rank—yet no gratitude was heard, and his arrogance grew only worse.
units.literal: Last summer's affair had some slight sincerity; reward and promotion were bent to add beyond rank and order—gratitude and joy were not heard, overbearing rivalry grew all the more manifest.

units.zh: 遂復矯構風塵，妄惑朱紫，詆貶朝政，疑閒親賢。
units.en: Then again he stirred up trouble, confusing high and low office, slandering the government and sowing doubt among kin and worthies.
units.literal: Then again he falsely constructed wind and dust, recklessly confusing purple and red, slandering court governance, sowing doubt and estranging kin and worthies.

units.zh: 巧言利口，見醜前志，涓流纖孽，作戒遠圖。
units.en: Clever words and sharp tongue are condemned in the histories; small streams of evil make warnings for far-reaching plans.
units.literal: Clever words and sharp tongue are seen as ugly in former records; trickling streams and slender evils make warnings for far-reaching plans.

units.zh: 宜有少正之刑，以申去害之義。
units.en: He should receive the punishment of Shaozheng, to declare the meaning of removing harm.
units.literal: He should receive the punishment of Shaozheng, to declare the meaning of removing harm.

units.zh: 便可收付廷尉，肅明國典。」
units.en: Take him at once to the Minister of Justice and solemnly apply the state code."
units.literal: He may at once be taken and handed to the Minister of Justice, solemnly clarifying the state code."

units.zh: 又使御史中丞范岫奏收朓，下獄死。
units.en: He also had Censor-in-Chief Fan Xiu memorialize to arrest Tiao; he was imprisoned and executed.
units.literal: He also had Censor-in-Chief Fan Xiu memorialize to arrest Tiao; he was imprisoned and died.

units.zh: 時年三十六。
units.en: He was thirty-six years old.
units.literal: He was then thirty-six years old.

units.zh: 朓初告王敬則，敬則女爲朓妻，常懷刀欲報朓，朓不敢相見。
units.en: When Tiao first reported Wang Jingze, Jingze's daughter was Tiao's wife and often carried a knife to avenge her father; Tiao did not dare meet her.
units.literal: When Tiao first reported Wang Jingze, Jingze's daughter was Tiao's wife and constantly carried a knife wishing to take revenge on Tiao; Tiao did not dare meet her.

units.zh: 及爲吏部郎，沈昭略謂朓曰：「卿人地之美，無忝此職。
units.en: When he became Attendant of the Ministry of Personnel, Shen Zhaolue said to him, "Your birth and talent do not disgrace this office.
units.literal: When he became Attendant of the Ministry of Personnel, Shen Zhaolue said to Tiao: "Your person and place are beautiful—you do not disgrace this office.

units.zh: 但恨今日刑于寡妻。」
units.en: I only regret that today you suffer at the hands of a widowed wife."
units.literal: I only regret that today you suffer punishment from a widowed wife."

units.zh: 朓臨敗歎曰：「我不殺王公，王公由我而死。」
units.en: Facing ruin Tiao sighed, "I did not kill the prince, but the prince died because of me."
units.literal: Facing defeat Tiao sighed: "I did not kill the prince, but the prince died because of me."

units.zh: 【評贊】
units.en: Historian's Commentary and Praise
units.literal: Commentary and Praise

units.zh: 史臣曰：晉世遷宅江表，人無北歸之計，英霸作輔，芟定中原，彌見金德之不競也。
units.en: The historian says: In the Jin age the court moved south of the Yangzi and men abandoned any plan to return north; when heroic ministers briefly reconquered the Central Plains, it only showed how far the Jin mandate had fallen.
units.literal: The historian says: In the Jin age they moved their residence south of the Yangzi; men had no plan to return north. When heroic hegemons served as assistants and mowed down the Central Plains, it only showed all the more that the Jin virtue could not compete.

units.zh: 元嘉再略河南，師旅傾覆，自此以來，攻伐寢議。
units.en: In Yuanjia they again seized Henan, but the armies were destroyed; since then offensive war has scarcely been debated.
units.literal: In Yuanjia they again seized Henan, but armies overturned and collapsed; from then on, campaigns and attacks ceased from discussion.

units.zh: 雖有戰爭，事存保境。
units.en: Though war continued, the aim remained merely to hold the borders.
units.literal: Though there was war, the affair remained preserving the borders.

units.zh: 王融生遇永明，軍國寧息，以文敏才華，不足進取，經略心旨，殷懃表奏。
units.en: Wang Rong was born in the Yongming era, when army and state were at peace; his literary brilliance could not win advancement by office alone, so he poured his strategic vision into earnest memorials.
units.literal: Wang Rong was born into Yongming, when army and state were tranquil; with literary quickness and talent insufficient for advancement by office, he put his strategic intent into earnest memorials.

units.zh: 若使宮車未晏，有事邊關，融之報效，或不易限。
units.en: If the emperor had not died young and trouble had arisen at the frontier, Rong's service might have been hard to limit.
units.literal: If the imperial carriage had not yet grown late and there were affairs at the frontier passes, Rong's repayment of service might not have been easy to limit.

units.zh: 夫經國體遠，許久爲難，而立功立事，信居物右，其賈誼終軍之流亞乎！
units.en: To govern the state with far-reaching vision is acknowledged as difficult, yet to achieve real deeds truly stands above common things—is he not of the company of Jia Yi and Zhong Jun!
units.literal: Governing the state and embodying the far—such is acknowledged as difficult; yet establishing achievement and establishing affairs truly stand to the right among things—is he not next after the stream of Jia Yi and Zhong Jun!

units.zh: 贊曰：元長穎脫，拊翼將飛。
units.en: The praise says: Yuanchang was brilliant and ready, beating his wings to fly.
units.literal: The praise says: Yuanchang was sharp and outstanding, beating wings about to fly.

units.zh: 時來運往，身沒志違。
units.en: The time came and fortune passed; he died and his will was thwarted.
units.literal: The time came and fortune passed; the body perished and the will was thwarted.

units.zh: 高宗始業，乃顧玄暉。
units.en: When the High Ancestor began his enterprise, he turned to Xuanhui.
units.literal: When the High Ancestor began his enterprise, he then turned to Xuanhui.

units.zh: 逢昏屬亂，先蹈禍機。
units.en: Meeting a benighted age and chaotic times, he was first to tread the path of disaster.
units.literal: Meeting a benighted age belonging to chaos, he first trod the mechanism of disaster.
